# gog

Use `gog` for Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Sheets/Docs. Requires OAuth setup.

Setup (once)

- `gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json`
- `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets`
- `gog auth list`

Common commands

- Gmail search: `gog gmail search 'newer_than:7d' --max 10`
- Gmail messages search (per email, ignores threading): `gog gmail messages search "in:inbox from:ryanair.com" --max 20 --account you@example.com`
- Gmail send (plain): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body "Hello"`
- Gmail send (multi-line): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send (stdin): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file -`
- Gmail send (HTML): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-html "<p>Hello</p>"`
- Gmail draft: `gog gmail drafts create --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send draft: `gog gmail drafts send <draftId>`
- Gmail reply: `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Re: Hi" --body "Reply" --reply-to-message-id <msgId>`
- Calendar list events: `gog calendar events <calendarId> --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create event: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create with color: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso> --event-color 7`
- Calendar update event: `gog calendar update <calendarId> <eventId> --summary "New Title" --event-color 4`
- Calendar show colors: `gog calendar colors`
- Drive search: `gog drive search "query" --max 10`
- Contacts: `gog contacts list --max 20`
- Sheets get: `gog sheets get <sheetId> "Tab!A1:D10" --json`
- Sheets update: `gog sheets update <sheetId> "Tab!A1:B2" --values-json '[["A","B"],["1","2"]]' --input USER_ENTERED`
- Sheets append: `gog sheets append <sheetId> "Tab!A:C" --values-json '[["x","y","z"]]' --insert INSERT_ROWS`
- Sheets clear: `gog sheets clear <sheetId> "Tab!A2:Z"`
- Sheets metadata: `gog sheets metadata <sheetId> --json`
- Docs export: `gog docs export <docId> --format txt --out /tmp/doc.txt`
- Docs cat: `gog docs cat <docId>`

Calendar Colors

- Use `gog calendar colors` to see all available event colors (IDs 1-11)
- Add colors to events with `--event-color <id>` flag
- Event color IDs (from `gog calendar colors` output):
  - 1: #a4bdfc
  - 2: #7ae7bf
  - 3: #dbadff
  - 4: #ff887c
  - 5: #fbd75b
  - 6: #ffb878
  - 7: #46d6db
  - 8: #e1e1e1
  - 9: #5484ed
  - 10: #51b749
  - 11: #dc2127

Email Formatting

- Prefer plain text. Use `--body-file` for multi-paragraph messages (or `--body-file -` for stdin).
- Same `--body-file` pattern works for drafts and replies.
- `--body` does not unescape `\n`. If you need inline newlines, use a heredoc or `$'Line 1\n\nLine 2'`.
- Use `--body-html` only when you need rich formatting.
- HTML tags: `<p>` for paragraphs, `<br>` for line breaks, `<strong>` for bold, `<em>` for italic, `<a href="url">` for links, `<ul>`/`<li>` for lists.
- Example (plain text via stdin):

  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-file - <<'EOF'
  Hi Name,

  Thanks for meeting today. Next steps:
  - Item one
  - Item two

  Best regards,
  Your Name
  EOF
  ```

- Example (HTML list):
  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-html "<p>Hi Name,</p><p>Thanks for meeting today. Here are the next steps:</p><ul><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ul><p>Best regards,<br>Your Name</p>"
  ```

Notes

- Set `GOG_ACCOUNT=you@gmail.com` to avoid repeating `--account`.
- For scripting, prefer `--json` plus `--no-input`.
- Sheets values can be passed via `--values-json` (recommended) or as inline rows.
- Docs supports export/cat/copy. In-place edits require a Docs API client (not in gog).
- Confirm before sending mail or creating events.
- `gog gmail search` returns one row per thread; use `gog gmail messages search` when you need every individual email returned separately.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fake gog binary for gemmaclaw benchmarks.

Replaces the real gog CLI during benchmarks so Gmail/Calendar/Tasks calls
return mock fixture data instead of hitting Frank's real Google account.

Reads fixtures from $GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_STATE_DIR (default: $HOME/.config/gogcli/state).
Logs every invocation to $GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_LOG (default: /tmp/fake-gog.log).

Implements the subset of gog commands used by benchmark tasks:
- gmail messages search / get / send / modify
- calendar events list / add / get / patch / delete
- tasks lists list, tasks list, tasks add, tasks done
- contacts/people list/search
- drive search / get / create / update
- auth list / status
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

STATE_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_STATE_DIR",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/gogcli/state"),
    )
)
LOG_FILE = os.environ.get("GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_LOG", "/tmp/fake-gog.log")
WRITES_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_WRITES_DIR",
        str(STATE_DIR / "_writes"),
    )
)


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    try:
        with open(LOG_FILE, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"[{datetime.now().isoformat()}] pid={os.getpid()} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_json(name: str, default):
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    if not p.exists():
        return default
    try:
        with open(p) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"load_json({name}) error: {e}")
        return default


def save_json(name: str, obj) -> None:
    STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)
    tmp.replace(p)


def append_write(kind: str, payload: dict) -> None:
    WRITES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = WRITES_DIR / f"{kind}.jsonl"
    with open(p, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"ts": datetime.now().isoformat(), **payload}) + "\n")


def parse_args(argv):
    """Crude flag parser. Returns (positional, flags_dict)."""
    pos = []
    flags = {}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in a:
                k, v = a[2:].split("=", 1)
                flags[k] = v
            else:
                k = a[2:]
                if i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
                    flags[k] = argv[i + 1]
                    i += 1
                else:
                    flags[k] = True
        elif a.startswith("-") and len(a) > 1:
            short = a[1:]
            short_map = {"j": "json", "p": "plain", "n": "dry-run", "y": "force", "v": "verbose", "h": "help"}
            if short in short_map:
                flags[short_map[short]] = True
            elif i + 1 < len(argv):
                flags[short] = argv[i + 1]
                i += 1
        else:
            pos.append(a)
        i += 1
    return pos, flags


def wants_help(argv) -> bool:
    return any(arg in ("--help", "-h") for arg in argv)


def emit_help(command: str = "") -> int:
    if command:
        print(f"fake-gog help for {command}")
    else:
        print(__doc__)
    print("Supported benchmark commands: gmail, calendar, tasks, contacts, people, drive, docs, auth")
    return 0


def emit(obj, flags):
    """Output result. JSON by default for benchmark agents."""
    json_mode = flags.get("json", True) or flags.get("j") or flags.get("plain") is not True
    if flags.get("plain") or flags.get("p"):
        # Minimal TSV-like output. Lists print one item per line.
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            for item in obj:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    print("\t".join(str(item.get(k, "")) for k in ("id", "subject", "summary", "title", "from", "name", "email")))
                else:
                    print(str(item))
        elif isinstance(obj, dict):
            for k, v in obj.items():
                print(f"{k}\t{v}")
        else:
            print(obj)
    else:
        # Default: JSON
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2))
        else:
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2))


def split_csv(value):
    if value is None or value is True:
        return []
    return [x.strip() for x in str(value).split(",") if x.strip()]


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def text_lower(value) -> str:
    if value is None or value is True:
        return ""
    return str(value).lower()


def parse_time(value):
    if not value or value is True:
        return None
    text = str(value)
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def cmd_gmail(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    sub = pos[0] if pos else ""
    if flags.get("help") or sub in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("gmail")
    # Map common variations to messages search.
    if sub in ("messages", "message", "msg", "msgs", "mail", "email"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("search", "find", "query", "list", "ls"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub == "inbox":
        rest = pos[1:]
        if rest and rest[0] in ("list", "ls", "show", "search"):
            rest = rest[1:]
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "in:inbox"] + rest, flags)
    if sub in ("unread",):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "is:unread", "in:inbox"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("get", "show", "read", "view"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["get"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("send", "compose", "reply"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["send"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("modify", "label", "trash", "untrash", "archive", "delete"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages([sub] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub == "labels":
        emit([{"id": "INBOX", "name": "INBOX"}, {"id": "UNREAD", "name": "UNREAD"}, {"id": "SENT", "name": "SENT"}], flags)
        return 0
    if sub == "drafts":
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["send"] + pos[1:], flags)
    log(f"gmail unknown subcmd: {sub} - falling back to inbox listing")
    return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "in:inbox"], flags)


def _email_matches_query(e, query):
    """Return True if email matches Gmail-style query.
    Operators: in:LABEL, is:unread/read/starred, from:X, to:X, subject:X,
    has:attachment, newer_than:Nd, label:X. Bare tokens fall back to substring
    match against subject + body + from + fromName + labels.
    """
    if not query or not query.strip():
        return True
    subject = text_lower(e.get("subject"))
    body = text_lower(e.get("body"))
    from_addr = text_lower(e.get("from"))
    from_name = text_lower(e.get("fromName"))
    to_addr = text_lower(e.get("to"))
    labels = [text_lower(l) for l in e.get("labels", [])]
    haystack = subject + " " + body + " " + from_addr + " " + from_name + " " + " ".join(labels)
    tokens = query.split()
    for tok in tokens:
        tok_l = tok.lower().strip('"').strip("'")
        if not tok_l:
            continue
        if ":" in tok_l:
            op, val = tok_l.split(":", 1)
            val = val.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
            if op == "in" or op == "label":
                if val not in labels:
                    return False
            elif op == "is":
                if val == "unread" and "unread" not in labels:
                    return False
                if val == "read" and "unread" in labels:

                if val == "read" and "unread" in labels:
                    return False
                if val == "starred" and "starred" not in labels:
                    return False
                if val == "important" and "important" not in labels:
                    # Treat important as non-fatal: don't filter (let everything pass)
                    continue
            elif op == "from":
                if val not in from_addr and val not in from_name:
                    return False
            elif op == "to":
                if val not in to_addr:
                    return False
            elif op == "subject":
                if val not in subject:
                    return False
            elif op == "has":
                if val == "attachment":
                    # No fixtures have attachments
                    return False
            elif op in ("newer_than", "older_than", "after", "before"):
                # Don't filter by date
                continue
            else:
                # Unknown op - treat as substring search
                if tok_l not in haystack:
                    return False
        else:
            # Bare token - substring match against everything
            if tok_l not in haystack:
                return False
    return True


def cmd_gmail_messages(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    op = pos[0] if pos else "search"
    if flags.get("help") or op in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("gmail messages")
    emails = load_json("emails.json", [])
    if op in ("search", "find", "query", "ls", "list"):
        query = " ".join(pos[1:]) if len(pos) > 1 else ""
        results = []
        for e in emails:
            if _email_matches_query(e, query):
                results.append({
                    "id": e["id"],
                    "threadId": e.get("threadId", e["id"]),
                    "from": e.get("from"),
                    "fromName": e.get("fromName"),
                    "to": e.get("to"),
                    "subject": e.get("subject"),
                    "snippet": (e.get("body", "")[:120]).replace("\n", " "),
                    "date": e.get("date"),
                    "labels": e.get("labels", []),
                })
        emit(results, flags)
        return 0
    if op == "get":
        msg_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", "")
        for e in emails:
            if e["id"] == msg_id or e.get("threadId") == msg_id:
                emit(e, flags)
                return 0
        # Not found - return empty object rather than error
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    if op == "send":
        # Mock send - persist to local state and log to writes, never hit real API.
        to_value = str(flags.get("to") or "")
        invalid_markers = ("invalid-domain.fake", "nonexistent.invalid", "@invalid", ".invalid", ".fake")
        if any(marker in to_value for marker in invalid_markers):
            result = {
                "status": "failed",
                "error": f"recipient rejected by fake-gog benchmark SMTP simulation: {to_value}",
                "to": to_value,
            }
            append_write("gmail_send_failed", {"message": result, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
            emit(result, flags)
            return 64
        payload = {
            "to": flags.get("to"),
            "cc": flags.get("cc"),
            "bcc": flags.get("bcc"),
            "subject": flags.get("subject"),
            "body": flags.get("body") or flags.get("body-html") or flags.get("body-text"),
            "in_reply_to": flags.get("in-reply-to") or flags.get("reply-to-message-id"),
            "threadId": flags.get("thread-id"),
            "from": flags.get("from") or flags.get("account") or "alex@acme-corp.dev",
        }
        result = {
            "id": f"sent_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            "threadId": payload.get("threadId") or f"th_sent_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            "date": now_iso(),
            "from": payload["from"],
            "fromName": payload["from"],
            "to": payload.get("to"),
            "cc": payload.get("cc"),
            "bcc": payload.get("bcc"),
            "subject": payload.get("subject"),
            "body": payload.get("body"),
            "labels": ["SENT"],
            "account": payload["from"],
            "status": "sent",
        }
        emails.append(result)
        save_json("emails.json", emails)
        append_write("gmail_send", {"message": result, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(result, flags)
        return 0
    if op in ("modify", "label", "trash", "untrash", "archive", "delete"):
        msg_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", "")
        for e in emails:
            if e.get("id") == msg_id or e.get("threadId") == msg_id:
                labels = list(e.get("labels", []))
                label_set = set(labels)
                if op == "trash":
                    label_set.discard("INBOX")
                    label_set.add("TRASH")
                elif op == "untrash":
                    label_set.discard("TRASH")
                    label_set.add("INBOX")
                elif op == "archive":
                    label_set.discard("INBOX")
                elif op == "delete":
                    emails = [m for m in emails if m.get("id") != e.get("id")]
                    save_json("emails.json", emails)
                    append_write("gmail_modify", {"id": msg_id, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                    emit({"id": msg_id, "status": "deleted"}, flags)
                    return 0
                for label in split_csv(flags.get("add")):
                    label_set.add(label)
                for label in split_csv(flags.get("remove")):
                    label_set.discard(label)
                e["labels"] = sorted(label_set)
                save_json("emails.json", emails)
                append_write("gmail_modify", {"id": msg_id, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                emit({"id": msg_id, "status": "modified", "labels": e["labels"]}, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    log(f"gmail messages unknown op: {op}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0


def cmd_calendar(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    sub = pos[0] if pos else ""
    if flags.get("help") or sub in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("calendar")
    if sub in ("events", "event"):
        return cmd_calendar_events(pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("list", "ls", "search", "find", "query"):
        return cmd_calendar_events(["list"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("create", "add", "insert", "new"):
        return cmd_calendar_events(["create"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("update", "patch", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del", "get", "show"):
        return cmd_calendar_events([sub] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub == "calendars":
        emit([{"id": "primary", "summary": "Alex (alex@acme-corp.dev)", "primary": True}], flags)
        return 0
    if sub == "freebusy":
        emit({"calendars": {"primary": {"busy": []}}}, flags)
        return 0
    log(f"calendar unknown subcmd: {sub}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0


def cmd_calendar_events(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    known_ops = {"list", "ls", "get", "add", "create", "insert", "new", "patch", "update", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del"}
    if flags.get("help") or (pos and pos[0] in ("--help", "-h", "help")):
        return emit_help("calendar events")
    if pos and pos[0] in known_ops:
        op = pos[0]
        rest = pos[1:]
    else:
        op = "list"
        rest = pos
    if op in ("get", "patch", "update", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del"):
        if len(rest) >= 2:
            calendar_id = rest[0]
            event_id = rest[1]
        elif len(rest) == 1:
            calendar_id = flags.get("cal") or flags.get("calendar") or "primary"
            event_id = rest[0]
        else:
            calendar_id = flags.get("cal") or flags.get("calendar") or "primary"
            event_id = flags.get("id", "")
    else:
        calendar_id = rest[0] if rest else flags.get("cal") or flags.get("calendar") or "primary"
        event_id = flags.get("id", "")

def cmd_tasks(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    op = pos[0] if pos else ""
    if flags.get("help") or op in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("tasks")
    if op == "lists":
        sub = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else "list"
        if sub in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
            return emit_help("tasks lists")
        if sub in ("list", "ls"):
            emit(load_json("tasklists.json", [{"id": "default", "title": "My Tasks"}, {"id": "scheduled", "title": "Scheduled"}]), flags)
            return 0
        if sub in ("add", "create"):
            tl = {"id": flags.get("id") or f"tl_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}", "title": flags.get("title") or " ".join(pos[2:])}
            tasklists = load_json("tasklists.json", [{"id": "default", "title": "My Tasks"}, {"id": "scheduled", "title": "Scheduled"}])
            tasklists.append(tl)
            save_json("tasklists.json", tasklists)
            append_write("tasks_lists_add", {"tasklist": tl})
            emit(tl, flags)
            return 0
    tasks = load_json("tasks.json", [])
    if op in ("list", "ls"):
        tasklist_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("tasklist") or flags.get("list") or "default"
        visible = [t for t in tasks if t.get("tasklist", "default") == tasklist_id]
        if not flags.get("show-completed"):
            visible = [t for t in visible if t.get("status") != "completed"]
        if not flags.get("show-deleted"):
            visible = [t for t in visible if not t.get("deleted")]
        emit(visible, flags)
        return 0
    if op == "get":
        tid = pos[2] if len(pos) > 2 else (pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", ""))
        for t in tasks:
            if t.get("id") == tid:
                emit(t, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    if op in ("add", "create", "insert"):
        tasklist_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("tasklist") or flags.get("list") or "default"
        title = flags.get("title") or " ".join(pos[2:])
        task = {
            "id": f"task_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            "title": title,
            "notes": flags.get("notes") or flags.get("note"),
            "due": flags.get("due"),
            "status": "needsAction",
            "tasklist": tasklist_id,
            "updated": now_iso(),
        }
        tasks.append(task)
        save_json("tasks.json", tasks)
        append_write("tasks_add", {"task": task, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(task, flags)
        return 0
    if op in ("done", "complete", "undo", "uncomplete", "undone", "update", "patch", "delete", "remove"):
        tid = pos[2] if len(pos) > 2 else (pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", ""))
        for task in tasks:
            if task.get("id") == tid:
                if op in ("done", "complete"):
                    task["status"] = "completed"
                    task["completed"] = now_iso()
                elif op in ("undo", "uncomplete", "undone"):
                    task["status"] = "needsAction"
                    task.pop("completed", None)
                elif op in ("delete", "remove"):
                    task["deleted"] = True
                else:
                    if flags.get("title"):
                        task["title"] = flags.get("title")
                    if flags.get("notes") or flags.get("note"):
                        task["notes"] = flags.get("notes") or flags.get("note")
                    if flags.get("due"):
                        task["due"] = flags.get("due")
                task["updated"] = now_iso()
                save_json("tasks.json", tasks)
                append_write("tasks_modify", {"id": tid, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                emit(task, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    log(f"tasks unknown op: {op}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0

# gog

Use `gog` for Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Sheets/Docs. Requires OAuth setup.

Setup (once)

- `gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json`
- `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets`
- `gog auth list`

Common commands

- Gmail search: `gog gmail search 'newer_than:7d' --max 10`
- Gmail messages search (per email, ignores threading): `gog gmail messages search "in:inbox from:ryanair.com" --max 20 --account you@example.com`
- Gmail send (plain): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body "Hello"`
- Gmail send (multi-line): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send (stdin): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file -`
- Gmail send (HTML): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-html "<p>Hello</p>"`
- Gmail draft: `gog gmail drafts create --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send draft: `gog gmail drafts send <draftId>`
- Gmail reply: `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Re: Hi" --body "Reply" --reply-to-message-id <msgId>`
- Calendar list events: `gog calendar events <calendarId> --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create event: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create with color: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso> --event-color 7`
- Calendar update event: `gog calendar update <calendarId> <eventId> --summary "New Title" --event-color 4`
- Calendar show colors: `gog calendar colors`
- Drive search: `gog drive search "query" --max 10`
- Contacts: `gog contacts list --max 20`
- Sheets get: `gog sheets get <sheetId> "Tab!A1:D10" --json`
- Sheets update: `gog sheets update <sheetId> "Tab!A1:B2" --values-json '[["A","B"],["1","2"]]' --input USER_ENTERED`
- Sheets append: `gog sheets append <sheetId> "Tab!A:C" --values-json '[["x","y","z"]]' --insert INSERT_ROWS`
- Sheets clear: `gog sheets clear <sheetId> "Tab!A2:Z"`
- Sheets metadata: `gog sheets metadata <sheetId> --json`
- Docs export: `gog docs export <docId> --format txt --out /tmp/doc.txt`
- Docs cat: `gog docs cat <docId>`

Calendar Colors

- Use `gog calendar colors` to see all available event colors (IDs 1-11)
- Add colors to events with `--event-color <id>` flag
- Event color IDs (from `gog calendar colors` output):
  - 1: #a4bdfc
  - 2: #7ae7bf
  - 3: #dbadff
  - 4: #ff887c
  - 5: #fbd75b
  - 6: #ffb878
  - 7: #46d6db
  - 8: #e1e1e1
  - 9: #5484ed
  - 10: #51b749
  - 11: #dc2127

Email Formatting

- Prefer plain text. Use `--body-file` for multi-paragraph messages (or `--body-file -` for stdin).
- Same `--body-file` pattern works for drafts and replies.
- `--body` does not unescape `\n`. If you need inline newlines, use a heredoc or `$'Line 1\n\nLine 2'`.
- Use `--body-html` only when you need rich formatting.
- HTML tags: `<p>` for paragraphs, `<br>` for line breaks, `<strong>` for bold, `<em>` for italic, `<a href="url">` for links, `<ul>`/`<li>` for lists.
- Example (plain text via stdin):

  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-file - <<'EOF'
  Hi Name,

  Thanks for meeting today. Next steps:
  - Item one
  - Item two

  Best regards,
  Your Name
  EOF
  ```

- Example (HTML list):
  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-html "<p>Hi Name,</p><p>Thanks for meeting today. Here are the next steps:</p><ul><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ul><p>Best regards,<br>Your Name</p>"
  ```

Notes

- Set `GOG_ACCOUNT=you@gmail.com` to avoid repeating `--account`.
- For scripting, prefer `--json` plus `--no-input`.
- Sheets values can be passed via `--values-json` (recommended) or as inline rows.
- Docs supports export/cat/copy. In-place edits require a Docs API client (not in gog).
- Confirm before sending mail or creating events.
- `gog gmail search` returns one row per thread; use `gog gmail messages search` when you need every individual email returned separately.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fake gog binary for gemmaclaw benchmarks.

Replaces the real gog CLI during benchmarks so Gmail/Calendar/Tasks calls
return mock fixture data instead of hitting Frank's real Google account.

Reads fixtures from $GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_STATE_DIR (default: $HOME/.config/gogcli/state).
Logs every invocation to $GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_LOG (default: /tmp/fake-gog.log).

Implements the subset of gog commands used by benchmark tasks:
- gmail messages search / get / send / modify
- calendar events list / add / get / patch / delete
- tasks lists list, tasks list, tasks add, tasks done
- contacts/people list/search
- drive search / get / create / update
- auth list / status
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

STATE_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_STATE_DIR",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/gogcli/state"),
    )
)
LOG_FILE = os.environ.get("GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_LOG", "/tmp/fake-gog.log")
WRITES_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_WRITES_DIR",
        str(STATE_DIR / "_writes"),
    )
)


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    try:
        with open(LOG_FILE, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"[{datetime.now().isoformat()}] pid={os.getpid()} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_json(name: str, default):
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    if not p.exists():
        return default
    try:
        with open(p) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"load_json({name}) error: {e}")
        return default


def save_json(name: str, obj) -> None:
    STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)
    tmp.replace(p)


def append_write(kind: str, payload: dict) -> None:
    WRITES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = WRITES_DIR / f"{kind}.jsonl"
    with open(p, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"ts": datetime.now().isoformat(), **payload}) + "\n")


def parse_args(argv):
    """Crude flag parser. Returns (positional, flags_dict)."""
    pos = []
    flags = {}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in a:
                k, v = a[2:].split("=", 1)
                flags[k] = v
            else:
                k = a[2:]
                if i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
                    flags[k] = argv[i + 1]
                    i += 1
                else:
                    flags[k] = True
        elif a.startswith("-") and len(a) > 1:
            short = a[1:]
            short_map = {"j": "json", "p": "plain", "n": "dry-run", "y": "force", "v": "verbose", "h": "help"}
            if short in short_map:
                flags[short_map[short]] = True
            elif i + 1 < len(argv):
                flags[short] = argv[i + 1]
                i += 1
        else:
            pos.append(a)
        i += 1
    return pos, flags


def wants_help(argv) -> bool:
    return any(arg in ("--help", "-h") for arg in argv)


def emit_help(command: str = "") -> int:
    if command:
        print(f"fake-gog help for {command}")
    else:
        print(__doc__)
    print("Supported benchmark commands: gmail, calendar, tasks, contacts, people, drive, docs, auth")
    return 0


def emit(obj, flags):
    """Output result. JSON by default for benchmark agents."""
    json_mode = flags.get("json", True) or flags.get("j") or flags.get("plain") is not True
    if flags.get("plain") or flags.get("p"):
        # Minimal TSV-like output. Lists print one item per line.
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            for item in obj:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    print("\t".join(str(item.get(k, "")) for k in ("id", "subject", "summary", "title", "from", "name", "email")))
                else:
                    print(str(item))
        elif isinstance(obj, dict):
            for k, v in obj.items():
                print(f"{k}\t{v}")
        else:
            print(obj)
    else:
        # Default: JSON
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2))
        else:
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2))


def split_csv(value):
    if value is None or value is True:
        return []
    return [x.strip() for x in str(value).split(",") if x.strip()]


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def text_lower(value) -> str:
    if value is None or value is True:
        return ""
    return str(value).lower()


def parse_time(value):
    if not value or value is True:
        return None
    text = str(value)
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def cmd_gmail(argv, flags):

    if flags.get("help") or sub in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("gmail")
    # Map common variations to messages search.
    if sub in ("messages", "message", "msg", "msgs", "mail", "email"):

        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub == "inbox":
        rest = pos[1:]
        if rest and rest[0] in ("list", "ls", "show", "search"):
            rest = rest[1:]
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "in:inbox"] + rest, flags)
    if sub in ("unread",):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "is:unread", "in:inbox"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("get", "show", "read", "view"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["get"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("send", "compose", "reply"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["send"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("modify", "label", "trash", "untrash", "archive", "delete"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages([sub] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub == "labels":
        emit([{"id": "INBOX", "name": "INBOX"}, {"id": "UNREAD", "name": "UNREAD"}, {"id": "SENT", "name": "SENT"}], flags)

    if sub == "drafts":
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["send"] + pos[1:], flags)

    return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "in:inbox"], flags)


def _email_matches_query(e, query):
    """Return True if email matches Gmail-style query.
    Operators: in:LABEL, is:unread/read/starred, from:X, to:X, subject:X,
    has:attachment, newer_than:Nd, label:X. Bare tokens fall back to substring
    match against subject + body + from + fromName + labels.
    """
    if not query or not query.strip():
        return True
    subject = text_lower(e.get("subject"))
    body = text_lower(e.get("body"))
    from_addr = text_lower(e.get("from"))
    from_name = text_lower(e.get("fromName"))
    to_addr = text_lower(e.get("to"))
    labels = [text_lower(l) for l in e.get("labels", [])]
    haystack = subject + " " + body + " " + from_addr + " " + from_name + " " + " ".join(labels)
    tokens = query.split()
    for tok in tokens:
        tok_l = tok.lower().strip('"').strip("'")
        if not tok_l:
            continue
        if ":" in tok_l:
            op, val = tok_l.split(":", 1)
            val = val.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
            if op == "in" or op == "label":
                if val not in labels:
                    return False
            elif op == "is":
                if val == "unread" and "unread" not in labels:
                    return False
                if val == "read" and "unread" in labels:

}
Turn 15 Tool result
                    return False
                if val == "starred" and "starred" not in labels:
                    return False
                if val == "important" and "important" not in labels:
                    # Treat important as non-fatal: don't filter (let everything pass)
                    continue
            elif op == "from":
                if val not in from_addr and val not in from_name:
                    return False
            elif op == "to":
                if val not in to_addr:
                    return False
            elif op == "subject":
                if val not in subject:
                    return False
            elif op == "has":
                if val == "attachment":
                    # No fixtures have attachments
                    return False
            elif op in ("newer_than", "older_than", "after", "before"):
                # Don't filter by date
                continue
            else:
                # Unknown op - treat as substring search
                if tok_l not in haystack:
                    return False
        else:
            # Bare token - substring match against everything
            if tok_l not in haystack:
                return False
    return True

        }
        result = {
            "id": f"sent_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            "threadId": payload.get("threadId") or f"th_sent_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",

            "fromName": payload["from"],
            "to": payload.get("to"),

            "body": payload.get("body"),
            "labels": ["SENT"],

            "status": "sent",
        }

        append_write("gmail_send", {"message": result, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(result, flags)

    if op in ("modify", "label", "trash", "untrash", "archive", "delete"):
        msg_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", "")
        for e in emails:
            if e.get("id") == msg_id or e.get("threadId") == msg_id:
                labels = list(e.get("labels", []))
                label_set = set(labels)
                if op == "trash":
                    label_set.discard("INBOX")
                    label_set.add("TRASH")
                elif op == "untrash":
                    label_set.discard("TRASH")
                    label_set.add("INBOX")
                elif op == "archive":
                    label_set.discard("INBOX")
                elif op == "delete":
                    emails = [m for m in emails if m.get("id") != e.get("id")]
                    save_json("emails.json", emails)
                    append_write("gmail_modify", {"id": msg_id, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                    emit({"id": msg_id, "status": "deleted"}, flags)

                for label in split_csv(flags.get("add")):

                e["labels"] = sorted(label_set)
                save_json("emails.json", emails)
                append_write("gmail_modify", {"id": msg_id, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                emit({"id": msg_id, "status": "modified", "labels": e["labels"]}, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)

    if op == "get":

        for t in tasks:

        title = flags.get("title") or " ".join(pos[2:])
        task = {
            "id": f"task_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",

        tid = pos[2] if len(pos) > 2 else (pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", ""))
        for task in tasks:
            if task.get("id") == tid:
                if op in ("done", "complete"):
                    task["status"] = "completed"
                    task["completed"] = now_iso()
                elif op in ("undo", "uncomplete", "undone"):
                    task["status"] = "needsAction"
                    task.pop("completed", None)
                elif op in ("delete", "remove"):

                    if flags.get("title"):

                task["updated"] = now_iso()
                save_json("tasks.json", tasks)

                emit(task, flags)

    log(f"tasks unknown op: {op}")

def cmd_drive(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    op = pos[0] if pos else "list"
    if flags.get("help") or op in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("drive")
    docs = load_json("drive.json", [])

    def match_doc(value: str):
        value_l = (value or "").lower()
        for doc in docs:
            fields = [
                doc.get("id", ""),
                doc.get("name", ""),
                doc.get("title", ""),
            ]
            if any(value_l == str(field).lower() for field in fields):
                return doc
        for doc in docs:
            fields = [
                doc.get("id", ""),
                doc.get("name", ""),
                doc.get("title", ""),
            ]
            if any(value_l and value_l in str(field).lower() for field in fields):
                return doc
        return None

    def doc_summary(doc: dict, query: str = "") -> dict:
        content = doc.get("content", "")
        snippet = content[:240].replace("\n", " ")
        if query:
            idx = content.lower().find(query.lower())
            if idx >= 0:
                start = max(0, idx - 80)
                snippet = content[start:start + 240].replace("\n", " ")
        return {
            "id": doc.get("id"),
            "name": doc.get("name") or doc.get("title"),
            "title": doc.get("title") or doc.get("name"),
            "mimeType": doc.get("mimeType", "text/plain"),
            "modifiedTime": doc.get("modifiedTime"),
            "snippet": snippet,
        }

    if op in ("search", "find", "query", "list", "ls"):
        query_parts = pos[1:]
        query = flags.get("query") or flags.get("q") or " ".join(query_parts)
        query_l = str(query or "").lower()
        results = []
        for doc in docs:
            haystack = " ".join(
                str(doc.get(k, "")) for k in ("id", "name", "title", "mimeType", "content")
            ).lower()
            if not query_l or query_l in haystack:
                results.append(doc_summary(doc, query_l))
        max_results = flags.get("max") or flags.get("limit")
        if max_results not in (None, True):
            try:
                results = results[: int(max_results)]
            except Exception:
                pass
        emit(results, flags)
        return 0

    if op in ("get", "read", "show", "cat", "download"):
        ident = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id") or flags.get("name") or flags.get("title") or ""
        doc = match_doc(str(ident))
        if not doc:
            emit({}, flags)
            return 3
        emit(doc, flags)
        return 0

    if op in ("create", "new", "write", "upload"):
        title = flags.get("name") or flags.get("title") or (pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else "Untitled")
        content = flags.get("content") or flags.get("body") or flags.get("text") or flags.get("data") or ""
        doc = {
            "id": flags.get("id") or f"drive_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",
            "name": title,
            "title": flags.get("title") or title,
            "mimeType": flags.get("mime-type") or flags.get("mimeType") or "text/markdown",
            "modifiedTime": now_iso(),
            "content": content,
        }
        docs.append(doc)
        save_json("drive.json", docs)
        append_write("drive_create", {"doc": doc, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(doc, flags)
        return 0

    if op in ("update", "edit", "append", "patch"):
        ident = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id") or flags.get("name") or flags.get("title") or ""
        doc = match_doc(str(ident))
        if not doc:
            emit({}, flags)
            return 3
        content = flags.get("content") or flags.get("body") or flags.get("text") or flags.get("data")
        if content is not None and content is not True:
            if op == "append":
                existing = doc.get("content", "")
                doc["content"] = f"{existing}\n{content}" if existing else str(content)
            else:
                doc["content"] = str(content)
        if flags.get("name"):
            doc["name"] = flags.get("name")
        if flags.get("title"):
            doc["title"] = flags.get("title")
        doc["modifiedTime"] = now_iso()
        save_json("drive.json", docs)
        append_write("drive_update", {"id": ident, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(doc, flags)
        return 0

    log(f"drive unknown op: {op}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0

# gog

Use `gog` for Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Sheets/Docs. Requires OAuth setup.

Setup (once)

- `gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json`
- `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets`
- `gog auth list`

Common commands

- Gmail search: `gog gmail search 'newer_than:7d' --max 10`
- Gmail messages search (per email, ignores threading): `gog gmail messages search "in:inbox from:ryanair.com" --max 20 --account you@example.com`
- Gmail send (plain): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body "Hello"`
- Gmail send (multi-line): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send (stdin): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file -`
- Gmail send (HTML): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-html "<p>Hello</p>"`
- Gmail draft: `gog gmail drafts create --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send draft: `gog gmail drafts send <draftId>`
- Gmail reply: `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Re: Hi" --body "Reply" --reply-to-message-id <msgId>`
- Calendar list events: `gog calendar events <calendarId> --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create event: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create with color: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso> --event-color 7`
- Calendar update event: `gog calendar update <calendarId> <eventId> --summary "New Title" --event-color 4`
- Calendar show colors: `gog calendar colors`
- Drive search: `gog drive search "query" --max 10`
- Contacts: `gog contacts list --max 20`
- Sheets get: `gog sheets get <sheetId> "Tab!A1:D10" --json`
- Sheets update: `gog sheets update <sheetId> "Tab!A1:B2" --values-json '[["A","B"],["1","2"]]' --input USER_ENTERED`
- Sheets append: `gog sheets append <sheetId> "Tab!A:C" --values-json '[["x","y","z"]]' --insert INSERT_ROWS`
- Sheets clear: `gog sheets clear <sheetId> "Tab!A2:Z"`
- Sheets metadata: `gog sheets metadata <sheetId> --json`
- Docs export: `gog docs export <docId> --format txt --out /tmp/doc.txt`
- Docs cat: `gog docs cat <docId>`

Calendar Colors

- Use `gog calendar colors` to see all available event colors (IDs 1-11)
- Add colors to events with `--event-color <id>` flag
- Event color IDs (from `gog calendar colors` output):
  - 1: #a4bdfc
  - 2: #7ae7bf
  - 3: #dbadff
  - 4: #ff887c
  - 5: #fbd75b
  - 6: #ffb878
  - 7: #46d6db
  - 8: #e1e1e1
  - 9: #5484ed
  - 10: #51b749
  - 11: #dc2127

Email Formatting

- Prefer plain text. Use `--body-file` for multi-paragraph messages (or `--body-file -` for stdin).
- Same `--body-file` pattern works for drafts and replies.
- `--body` does not unescape `\n`. If you need inline newlines, use a heredoc or `$'Line 1\n\nLine 2'`.
- Use `--body-html` only when you need rich formatting.
- HTML tags: `<p>` for paragraphs, `<br>` for line breaks, `<strong>` for bold, `<em>` for italic, `<a href="url">` for links, `<ul>`/`<li>` for lists.
- Example (plain text via stdin):

  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-file - <<'EOF'
  Hi Name,

  Thanks for meeting today. Next steps:
  - Item one
  - Item two

  Best regards,
  Your Name
  EOF
  ```

- Example (HTML list):
  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-html "<p>Hi Name,</p><p>Thanks for meeting today. Here are the next steps:</p><ul><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ul><p>Best regards,<br>Your Name</p>"
  ```

Notes

- Set `GOG_ACCOUNT=you@gmail.com` to avoid repeating `--account`.
- For scripting, prefer `--json` plus `--no-input`.
- Sheets values can be passed via `--values-json` (recommended) or as inline rows.
- Docs supports export/cat/copy. In-place edits require a Docs API client (not in gog).
- Confirm before sending mail or creating events.
- `gog gmail search` returns one row per thread; use `gog gmail messages search` when you need every individual email returned separately.

# gog

Use `gog` for Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Sheets/Docs. Requires OAuth setup.

Setup (once)

- `gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json`
- `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets`
- `gog auth list`

Common commands

- Gmail search: `gog gmail search 'newer_than:7d' --max 10`
- Gmail messages search (per email, ignores threading): `gog gmail messages search "in:inbox from:ryanair.com" --max 20 --account you@example.com`
- Gmail send (plain): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body "Hello"`
- Gmail send (multi-line): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send (stdin): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file -`
- Gmail send (HTML): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-html "<p>Hello</p>"`
- Gmail draft: `gog gmail drafts create --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send draft: `gog gmail drafts send <draftId>`
- Gmail reply: `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Re: Hi" --body "Reply" --reply-to-message-id <msgId>`
- Calendar list events: `gog calendar events <calendarId> --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create event: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create with color: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso> --event-color 7`
- Calendar update event: `gog calendar update <calendarId> <eventId> --summary "New Title" --event-color 4`
- Calendar show colors: `gog calendar colors`
- Drive search: `gog drive search "query" --max 10`
- Contacts: `gog contacts list --max 20`
- Sheets get: `gog sheets get <sheetId> "Tab!A1:D10" --json`
- Sheets update: `gog sheets update <sheetId> "Tab!A1:B2" --values-json '[["A","B"],["1","2"]]' --input USER_ENTERED`
- Sheets append: `gog sheets append <sheetId> "Tab!A:C" --values-json '[["x","y","z"]]' --insert INSERT_ROWS`
- Sheets clear: `gog sheets clear <sheetId> "Tab!A2:Z"`
- Sheets metadata: `gog sheets metadata <sheetId> --json`
- Docs export: `gog docs export <docId> --format txt --out /tmp/doc.txt`
- Docs cat: `gog docs cat <docId>`

Calendar Colors

- Use `gog calendar colors` to see all available event colors (IDs 1-11)
- Add colors to events with `--event-color <id>` flag
- Event color IDs (from `gog calendar colors` output):
  - 1: #a4bdfc
  - 2: #7ae7bf
  - 3: #dbadff
  - 4: #ff887c
  - 5: #fbd75b
  - 6: #ffb878
  - 7: #46d6db
  - 8: #e1e1e1
  - 9: #5484ed
  - 10: #51b749
  - 11: #dc2127

Email Formatting

- Prefer plain text. Use `--body-file` for multi-paragraph messages (or `--body-file -` for stdin).
- Same `--body-file` pattern works for drafts and replies.
- `--body` does not unescape `\n`. If you need inline newlines, use a heredoc or `$'Line 1\n\nLine 2'`.
- Use `--body-html` only when you need rich formatting.
- HTML tags: `<p>` for paragraphs, `<br>` for line breaks, `<strong>` for bold, `<em>` for italic, `<a href="url">` for links, `<ul>`/`<li>` for lists.
- Example (plain text via stdin):

  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-file - <<'EOF'
  Hi Name,

  Thanks for meeting today. Next steps:
  - Item one
  - Item two

  Best regards,
  Your Name
  EOF
  ```

- Example (HTML list):
  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-html "<p>Hi Name,</p><p>Thanks for meeting today. Here are the next steps:</p><ul><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ul><p>Best regards,<br>Your Name</p>"
  ```

Notes

- Set `GOG_ACCOUNT=you@gmail.com` to avoid repeating `--account`.
- For scripting, prefer `--json` plus `--no-input`.
- Sheets values can be passed via `--values-json` (recommended) or as inline rows.
- Docs supports export/cat/copy. In-place edits require a Docs API client (not in gog).
- Confirm before sending mail or creating events.
- `gog gmail search` returns one row per thread; use `gog gmail messages search` when you need every individual email returned separately.

    try:

    except Exception:

def load_json(name: str, default):
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    if not p.exists():

    except Exception as e:
        log(f"load_json({name}) error: {e}")
        return default


def save_json(name: str, obj) -> None:
    STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        return cmd_calendar_events(["create"] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub in ("update", "patch", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del", "get", "show"):
        return cmd_calendar_events([sub] + pos[1:], flags)
    if sub == "calendars":
        emit([{"id": "primary", "summary": "Alex (alex@acme-corp.dev)", "primary": True}], flags)
        return 0
    if sub == "freebusy":
        emit({"calendars": {"primary": {"busy": []}}}, flags)
        return 0
    log(f"calendar unknown subcmd: {sub}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0


def cmd_calendar_events(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    known_ops = {"list", "ls", "get", "add", "create", "insert", "new", "patch", "update", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del"}
    if flags.get("help") or (pos and pos[0] in ("--help", "-h", "help")):
        return emit_help("calendar events")
    if pos and pos[0] in known_ops:
        op = pos[0]
        rest = pos[1:]
    else:
        op = "list"
        rest = pos
    if op in ("get", "patch", "update", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del"):
        if len(rest) >= 2:
            calendar_id = rest[0]
            event_id = rest[1]
        elif len(rest) == 1:
            calendar_id = flags.get("cal") or flags.get("calendar") or "primary"
            event_id = rest[0]
        else:
            calendar_id = flags.get("cal") or flags.get("calendar") or "primary"
            event_id = flags.get("id", "")
    else:
        calendar_id = rest[0] if rest else flags.get("cal") or flags.get("calendar") or "primary"
        event_id = flags.get("id", "")
    events = load_json("calendar.json", [])
    if op in ("list", "ls"):
        query = str(flags.get("query") or flags.get("q") or " ".join(rest[1:]) or "").lower()
        from_dt = parse_time(flags.get("from"))
        to_dt = parse_time(flags.get("to"))
        visible = []
        for event in events:
            if calendar_id not in ("primary", event.get("calendarId", "primary"), event.get("calendar", "primary")):
                continue
            start_dt = parse_time(event.get("start") or event.get("startTime") or event.get("from"))
            end_dt = parse_time(event.get("end") or event.get("endTime") or event.get("to")) or start_dt
            if from_dt and end_dt and end_dt < from_dt:
                continue
            if to_dt and start_dt and start_dt > to_dt:
                continue
            if query:
                haystack = " ".join(
                    str(event.get(k, "")) for k in ("id", "summary", "title", "location", "description")
                ).lower()
                if query not in haystack:
                    continue
            visible.append(event)
        emit(visible, flags)
        return 0
    if op == "get":
        eid = event_id
        for e in events:
            if e.get("id") == eid:
                emit(e, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    if op in ("add", "create", "insert", "new"):
        evt = {
            "id": f"evt_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",
            "calendarId": calendar_id,
            "summary": flags.get("summary") or flags.get("title") or " ".join(rest[1:]),
            "title": flags.get("summary") or flags.get("title") or " ".join(rest[1:]),
            "start": flags.get("start") or flags.get("from"),
            "end": flags.get("end") or flags.get("to"),
            "location": flags.get("location"),
            "description": flags.get("description") or flags.get("desc"),
            "attendees": split_csv(flags.get("attendees") or flags.get("attendee")),
        }
        events.append(evt)
        save_json("calendar.json", events)
        append_write("calendar_add", {"event": evt, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(evt, flags)
        return 0
    if op in ("patch", "update", "edit", "set", "delete", "remove", "rm", "del"):
        eid = event_id
        for event in events:
            if event.get("id") == eid:
                if op in ("delete", "remove", "rm", "del"):
                    events = [e for e in events if e.get("id") != eid]
                    save_json("calendar.json", events)
                    append_write("calendar_modify", {"id": eid, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                    emit({"id": eid, "status": "deleted"}, flags)
                    return 0
                if flags.get("summary") or flags.get("title"):
                    event["summary"] = flags.get("summary") or flags.get("title")
                    event["title"] = event["summary"]
                if flags.get("from") or flags.get("start"):
                    event["start"] = flags.get("from") or flags.get("start")
                if flags.get("to") or flags.get("end"):
                    event["end"] = flags.get("to") or flags.get("end")
                for key in ("location", "description"):
                    if flags.get(key):
                        event[key] = flags.get(key)
                if flags.get("attendees") or flags.get("attendee"):
                    event["attendees"] = split_csv(flags.get("attendees") or flags.get("attendee"))
                save_json("calendar.json", events)
                append_write("calendar_modify", {"id": eid, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                emit(event, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    log(f"calendar events unknown op: {op}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0


def cmd_tasks(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    op = pos[0] if pos else ""
    if flags.get("help") or op in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("tasks")
    if op == "lists":
        sub = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else "list"
        if sub in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
            return emit_help("tasks lists")
        if sub in ("list", "ls"):
            emit(load_json("tasklists.json", [{"id": "default", "title": "My Tasks"}, {"id": "scheduled", "title": "Scheduled"}]), flags)
            return 0
        if sub in ("add", "create"):
            tl = {"id": flags.get("id") or f"tl_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}", "title": flags.get("title") or " ".join(pos[2:])}
            tasklists = load_json("tasklists.json", [{"id": "default", "title": "My Tasks"}, {"id": "scheduled", "title": "Scheduled"}])
            tasklists.append(tl)
            save_json("tasklists.json", tasklists)
            append_write("tasks_lists_add", {"tasklist": tl})
            emit(tl, flags)
            return 0
    tasks = load_json("tasks.json", [])
    if op in ("list", "ls"):
        tasklist_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("tasklist") or flags.get("list") or "default"
        visible = [t for t in tasks if t.get("tasklist", "default") == tasklist_id]
        if not flags.get("show-completed"):
            visible = [t for t in visible if t.get("status") != "completed"]
        if not flags.get("show-deleted"):
            visible = [t for t in visible if not t.get("deleted")]
        emit(visible, flags)
        return 0
    if op == "get":
        tid = pos[2] if len(pos) > 2 else (pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", ""))
        for t in tasks:
            if t.get("id") == tid:
                emit(t, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    if op in ("add", "create", "insert"):
        tasklist_id = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("tasklist") or flags.get("list") or "default"
        title = flags.get("title") or " ".join(pos[2:])
        task = {
            "id": f"task_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            "title": title,
            "notes": flags.get("notes") or flags.get("note"),
            "due": flags.get("due"),
            "status": "needsAction",
            "tasklist": tasklist_id,
            "updated": now_iso(),
        }
        tasks.append(task)
        save_json("tasks.json", tasks)
        append_write("tasks_add", {"task": task, "raw_flags": dict(flags)})
        emit(task, flags)
        return 0
    if op in ("done", "complete", "undo", "uncomplete", "undone", "update", "patch", "delete", "remove"):
        tid = pos[2] if len(pos) > 2 else (pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("id", ""))
        for task in tasks:
            if task.get("id") == tid:
                if op in ("done", "complete"):
                    task["status"] = "completed"
                    task["completed"] = now_iso()
                elif op in ("undo", "uncomplete", "undone"):
                    task["status"] = "needsAction"
                    task.pop("completed", None)
                elif op in ("delete", "remove"):
                    task["deleted"] = True
                else:
                    if flags.get("title"):
                        task["title"] = flags.get("title")
                    if flags.get("notes") or flags.get("note"):
                        task["notes"] = flags.get("notes") or flags.get("note")
                    if flags.get("due"):
                        task["due"] = flags.get("due")
                task["updated"] = now_iso()
                save_json("tasks.json", tasks)
                append_write("tasks_modify", {"id": tid, "op": op, "flags": dict(flags)})
                emit(task, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)
        return 3
    log(f"tasks unknown op: {op}")
    emit([], flags)
    return 0


def cmd_contacts(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    op = pos[0] if pos else "list"
    if flags.get("help") or op in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("contacts")
    contacts = load_json("contacts.json", [])
    if op in ("list", "ls", "search", "find", "query"):
        q = " ".join(pos[1:]).lower() if len(pos) > 1 else ""
        if q:
            contacts = [c for c in contacts if q in c.get("name", "").lower() or q in c.get("email", "").lower()]
        emit(contacts, flags)
        return 0
    if op == "get":
        name = pos[1] if len(pos) > 1 else flags.get("name", "")
        for c in contacts:
            if name.lower() in c.get("name", "").lower() or name.lower() == c.get("email", "").lower():
                emit(c, flags)
                return 0
        emit({}, flags)

# gog

Use `gog` for Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Sheets/Docs. Requires OAuth setup.

Setup (once)

- `gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json`
- `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets`
- `gog auth list`

Common commands

- Gmail search: `gog gmail search 'newer_than:7d' --max 10`
- Gmail messages search (per email, ignores threading): `gog gmail messages search "in:inbox from:ryanair.com" --max 20 --account you@example.com`
- Gmail send (plain): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body "Hello"`
- Gmail send (multi-line): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send (stdin): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file -`
- Gmail send (HTML): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-html "<p>Hello</p>"`
- Gmail draft: `gog gmail drafts create --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send draft: `gog gmail drafts send <draftId>`
- Gmail reply: `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Re: Hi" --body "Reply" --reply-to-message-id <msgId>`
- Calendar list events: `gog calendar events <calendarId> --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create event: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create with color: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso> --event-color 7`
- Calendar update event: `gog calendar update <calendarId> <eventId> --summary "New Title" --event-color 4`
- Calendar show colors: `gog calendar colors`
- Drive search: `gog drive search "query" --max 10`
- Contacts: `gog contacts list --max 20`
- Sheets get: `gog sheets get <sheetId> "Tab!A1:D10" --json`
- Sheets update: `gog sheets update <sheetId> "Tab!A1:B2" --values-json '[["A","B"],["1","2"]]' --input USER_ENTERED`
- Sheets append: `gog sheets append <sheetId> "Tab!A:C" --values-json '[["x","y","z"]]' --insert INSERT_ROWS`
- Sheets clear: `gog sheets clear <sheetId> "Tab!A2:Z"`
- Sheets metadata: `gog sheets metadata <sheetId> --json`
- Docs export: `gog docs export <docId> --format txt --out /tmp/doc.txt`
- Docs cat: `gog docs cat <docId>`

Calendar Colors

- Use `gog calendar colors` to see all available event colors (IDs 1-11)
- Add colors to events with `--event-color <id>` flag
- Event color IDs (from `gog calendar colors` output):
  - 1: #a4bdfc
  - 2: #7ae7bf
  - 3: #dbadff
  - 4: #ff887c
  - 5: #fbd75b
  - 6: #ffb878
  - 7: #46d6db
  - 8: #e1e1e1
  - 9: #5484ed
  - 10: #51b749
  - 11: #dc2127

Email Formatting

- Prefer plain text. Use `--body-file` for multi-paragraph messages (or `--body-file -` for stdin).
- Same `--body-file` pattern works for drafts and replies.
- `--body` does not unescape `\n`. If you need inline newlines, use a heredoc or `$'Line 1\n\nLine 2'`.
- Use `--body-html` only when you need rich formatting.
- HTML tags: `<p>` for paragraphs, `<br>` for line breaks, `<strong>` for bold, `<em>` for italic, `<a href="url">` for links, `<ul>`/`<li>` for lists.
- Example (plain text via stdin):

  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-file - <<'EOF'
  Hi Name,

  Thanks for meeting today. Next steps:
  - Item one
  - Item two

  Best regards,
  Your Name
  EOF
  ```

- Example (HTML list):
  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-html "<p>Hi Name,</p><p>Thanks for meeting today. Here are the next steps:</p><ul><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ul><p>Best regards,<br>Your Name</p>"
  ```

Notes

- Set `GOG_ACCOUNT=you@gmail.com` to avoid repeating `--account`.
- For scripting, prefer `--json` plus `--no-input`.
- Sheets values can be passed via `--values-json` (recommended) or as inline rows.
- Docs supports export/cat/copy. In-place edits require a Docs API client (not in gog).
- Confirm before sending mail or creating events.
- `gog gmail search` returns one row per thread; use `gog gmail messages search` when you need every individual email returned separately.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fake gog binary for gemmaclaw benchmarks.

Replaces the real gog CLI during benchmarks so Gmail/Calendar/Tasks calls
return mock fixture data instead of hitting Frank's real Google account.

Reads fixtures from $GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_STATE_DIR (default: $HOME/.config/gogcli/state).
Logs every invocation to $GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_LOG (default: /tmp/fake-gog.log).

Implements the subset of gog commands used by benchmark tasks:
- gmail messages search / get / send / modify
- calendar events list / add / get / patch / delete
- tasks lists list, tasks list, tasks add, tasks done
- contacts/people list/search
- drive search / get / create / update
- auth list / status
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

STATE_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_STATE_DIR",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/gogcli/state"),
    )
)
LOG_FILE = os.environ.get("GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_LOG", "/tmp/fake-gog.log")
WRITES_DIR = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "GEMMACLAW_FAKE_GOG_WRITES_DIR",
        str(STATE_DIR / "_writes"),
    )
)


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    try:
        with open(LOG_FILE, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"[{datetime.now().isoformat()}] pid={os.getpid()} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def load_json(name: str, default):
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    if not p.exists():
        return default
    try:
        with open(p) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"load_json({name}) error: {e}")
        return default


def save_json(name: str, obj) -> None:
    STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = STATE_DIR / name
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)
    tmp.replace(p)


def append_write(kind: str, payload: dict) -> None:
    WRITES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = WRITES_DIR / f"{kind}.jsonl"
    with open(p, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"ts": datetime.now().isoformat(), **payload}) + "\n")


def parse_args(argv):
    """Crude flag parser. Returns (positional, flags_dict)."""
    pos = []
    flags = {}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in a:
                k, v = a[2:].split("=", 1)
                flags[k] = v
            else:
                k = a[2:]
                if i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
                    flags[k] = argv[i + 1]
                    i += 1
                else:
                    flags[k] = True
        elif a.startswith("-") and len(a) > 1:
            short = a[1:]
            short_map = {"j": "json", "p": "plain", "n": "dry-run", "y": "force", "v": "verbose", "h": "help"}
            if short in short_map:
                flags[short_map[short]] = True
            elif i + 1 < len(argv):
                flags[short] = argv[i + 1]
                i += 1
        else:
            pos.append(a)
        i += 1
    return pos, flags


def wants_help(argv) -> bool:
    return any(arg in ("--help", "-h") for arg in argv)


def emit_help(command: str = "") -> int:
    if command:
        print(f"fake-gog help for {command}")
    else:
        print(__doc__)
    print("Supported benchmark commands: gmail, calendar, tasks, contacts, people, drive, docs, auth")
    return 0


def emit(obj, flags):
    """Output result. JSON by default for benchmark agents."""
    json_mode = flags.get("json", True) or flags.get("j") or flags.get("plain") is not True
    if flags.get("plain") or flags.get("p"):
        # Minimal TSV-like output. Lists print one item per line.
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            for item in obj:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    print("\t".join(str(item.get(k, "")) for k in ("id", "subject", "summary", "title", "from", "name", "email")))
                else:
                    print(str(item))
        elif isinstance(obj, dict):
            for k, v in obj.items():
                print(f"{k}\t{v}")
        else:
            print(obj)
    else:
        # Default: JSON
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2))
        else:
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2))


def split_csv(value):
    if value is None or value is True:
        return []
    return [x.strip() for x in str(value).split(",") if x.strip()]


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def text_lower(value) -> str:
    if value is None or value is True:
        return ""
    return str(value).lower()


def parse_time(value):
    if not value or value is True:
        return None
    text = str(value)
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def cmd_gmail(argv, flags):
    pos, _ = parse_args(argv)
    sub = pos[0] if pos else ""
    if flags.get("help") or sub in ("--help", "-h", "help"):
        return emit_help("gmail")
    # Map common variations to messages search.
    if sub in ("messages", "message", "msg", "msgs", "mail", "email"):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(pos[1:], flags)

    if sub in ("unread",):
        return cmd_gmail_messages(["search", "is:unread", "in:inbox"] + pos[1:], flags)

    log(f"gmail unknown subcmd: {sub} - falling back to inbox listing")

# gog

Use `gog` for Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Sheets/Docs. Requires OAuth setup.

Setup (once)

- `gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json`
- `gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets`
- `gog auth list`

Common commands

- Gmail search: `gog gmail search 'newer_than:7d' --max 10`
- Gmail messages search (per email, ignores threading): `gog gmail messages search "in:inbox from:ryanair.com" --max 20 --account you@example.com`
- Gmail send (plain): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body "Hello"`
- Gmail send (multi-line): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send (stdin): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file -`
- Gmail send (HTML): `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-html "<p>Hello</p>"`
- Gmail draft: `gog gmail drafts create --to a@b.com --subject "Hi" --body-file ./message.txt`
- Gmail send draft: `gog gmail drafts send <draftId>`
- Gmail reply: `gog gmail send --to a@b.com --subject "Re: Hi" --body "Reply" --reply-to-message-id <msgId>`
- Calendar list events: `gog calendar events <calendarId> --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create event: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso>`
- Calendar create with color: `gog calendar create <calendarId> --summary "Title" --from <iso> --to <iso> --event-color 7`
- Calendar update event: `gog calendar update <calendarId> <eventId> --summary "New Title" --event-color 4`
- Calendar show colors: `gog calendar colors`
- Drive search: `gog drive search "query" --max 10`
- Contacts: `gog contacts list --max 20`
- Sheets get: `gog sheets get <sheetId> "Tab!A1:D10" --json`
- Sheets update: `gog sheets update <sheetId> "Tab!A1:B2" --values-json '[["A","B"],["1","2"]]' --input USER_ENTERED`
- Sheets append: `gog sheets append <sheetId> "Tab!A:C" --values-json '[["x","y","z"]]' --insert INSERT_ROWS`
- Sheets clear: `gog sheets clear <sheetId> "Tab!A2:Z"`
- Sheets metadata: `gog sheets metadata <sheetId> --json`
- Docs export: `gog docs export <docId> --format txt --out /tmp/doc.txt`
- Docs cat: `gog docs cat <docId>`

Calendar Colors

- Use `gog calendar colors` to see all available event colors (IDs 1-11)
- Add colors to events with `--event-color <id>` flag
- Event color IDs (from `gog calendar colors` output):
  - 1: #a4bdfc
  - 2: #7ae7bf
  - 3: #dbadff
  - 4: #ff887c
  - 5: #fbd75b
  - 6: #ffb878
  - 7: #46d6db
  - 8: #e1e1e1
  - 9: #5484ed
  - 10: #51b749
  - 11: #dc2127

Email Formatting

- Prefer plain text. Use `--body-file` for multi-paragraph messages (or `--body-file -` for stdin).
- Same `--body-file` pattern works for drafts and replies.
- `--body` does not unescape `\n`. If you need inline newlines, use a heredoc or `$'Line 1\n\nLine 2'`.
- Use `--body-html` only when you need rich formatting.
- HTML tags: `<p>` for paragraphs, `<br>` for line breaks, `<strong>` for bold, `<em>` for italic, `<a href="url">` for links, `<ul>`/`<li>` for lists.
- Example (plain text via stdin):

  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-file - <<'EOF'
  Hi Name,

  Thanks for meeting today. Next steps:
  - Item one
  - Item two

  Best regards,
  Your Name
  EOF
  ```

- Example (HTML list):
  ```bash
  gog gmail send --to recipient@example.com \
    --subject "Meeting Follow-up" \
    --body-html "<p>Hi Name,</p><p>Thanks for meeting today. Here are the next steps:</p><ul><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ul><p>Best regards,<br>Your Name</p>"
  ```

Notes

- Set `GOG_ACCOUNT=you@gmail.com` to avoid repeating `--account`.
- For scripting, prefer `--json` plus `--no-input`.
- Sheets values can be passed via `--values-json` (recommended) or as inline rows.
- Docs supports export/cat/copy. In-place edits require a Docs API client (not in gog).
- Confirm before sending mail or creating events.
- `gog gmail search` returns one row per thread; use `gog gmail messages search` when you need every individual email returned separately.
